title: 1st Winner of Bug Bounty 2023
description: In this competition, I conducted penetration testing on a cloned version of the official Kemdikbud website. The vulnerabilities I discovered primarily included SQL Injection, Information Disclosure, and Unrestricted File Upload.

title: 3rd Winner of LKS Web Technology 2022
description: This competition is a provincial event for high schools in the Special Region of Yogyakarta. I participated in the Web Technology category, where participants were required to build a website presenting data from IMDb. I performed scraping from IMDb using JavaScript. The tech stack I used was Nest.js for the backend and Nuxt.js for the frontend.
